verdict.rationale: OneDrive exposes a documented REST API through Microsoft Graph, so this axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence shows a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent machine-readable spec, and the probe found every candidate OpenAPI/Swagger path returning 404. The human-readable endpoint reference pages do not count as a machine-readable spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
